'''Mónica Fernández-Aceytuno Saénz de Santa María''' (born 4 May 1961{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}) is a Spanish biologist and writer focused on [[Science outreach|public outreach]] on natural issues.

==Career==
Fernández-Aceytuno was born in [[Dakhla, Western Sahara|Dakhla]], Western Sahara where her father, a military man, was assigned. Although she only spent a few years there, this time was fundamental in the formation of her character and her discovery of nature.<ref name=Medio>{{Cite news |url=https://www.abc.es/hemeroteca/historico-25-07-2003/abc/Sociedad/monica-fernandez-aceytuno-premio-nacional-de-medio-ambiente_197096.html |title=Mónica Fernández-Aceytuno, Premio Nacional de Medio Ambiente |trans-title=Mónica Fernández-Aceytuno, National Environmental Award |first=A. |last=Acosta |work=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]] |location=Madrid |language=Spanish |date=25 July 2003 |access-date=1 February 2019}}</ref> She earned a [[Licentiate (degree)#Spain|licentiate]] in Biological Sciences from the [[Complutense University of Madrid]] in 1991 and began working at a laboratory. But after a few months' stay in Alaska, following in the footsteps of [[Félix Rodríguez de la Fuente]], she decided to leave the lab and dedicate herself to [[Science outreach|outreach]].{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}

She began publishing articles in the newspaper ''[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]'' in 1997, and for the digital media outlet ''{{ill|Republica.com|es}}'' in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.republica.com/lugar-de-la-vida/author/monica/ |title=Lugar de la vida |work=[[Republica.com]] |language=Spanish |access-date=1 February 2019 |archive-date=2 February 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190202095503/https://www.republica.com/lugar-de-la-vida/author/monica/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2007, she created her own Internet portal on which, with the sponsorship of the Aquae Foundation and the collaboration of readers, the ''Diccionario Aceytuno de la Naturaleza'' began.{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}

In 2015, she began to make a series of videos and micro-documentaries for various media. In her works, Fernández-Aceytuno habitually conjugates and combines nature and poetry. In the same year, she also made a series of presentations on the [[haiku]] book ''Lógica Sencilla'' by her brother, real estate expert Juan Fernández-Aceytuno.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://clubmatador.com/presentacion-del-libro-la-logica-sencilla/ |title=Presentación del libro la Lógica Sencilla |publisher=Club Matador |language=Spanish |access-date=1 February 2019}}</ref>

==Awards and recognitions==
In 2003, she received the ''Félix Rodríguez de la Fuente de Conservación de la Naturaleza'' [[National Environmental Award]] for her outreach work,<ref name=Medio/> and in 2007 the Jaime de Foxá Literary Prize awarded by the Real Club de Monteros.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.realclubdemonteros.es/premios-real-club-de-monteros |title=Premios Real Club de Monteros |publisher=Real Club de Monteros |language=Spanish |access-date=1 February 2019}}</ref> One year later, in October 2008, she received the Medal of Honor for Professional Merit from the College of Forestry Engineers for her activity in the press and on the Internet.<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://www.ingenierosdemontes.org/Descargas.aspx?doc=Memoria2011.pdf |title=Memoria Anual |publisher=College of Forestry Engineers |page=34 |language=Spanish |year=2011 |access-date=1 February 2019}}</ref> In 2016, she received the Outreach Communication award from the [[International Environmental Film Festival of the Canary Islands]] (''Festival Internacional de Cine Medioambiental de Canarias'', FICMEC).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ficmec.es/ficmec2016/noticia40.html |title=FICMEC entrega los Premios Brote |trans-title=FICMEC Presents the Outreach Awards |publisher=International Environmental Film Festival of the Canary Islands |language=Spanish |access-date=1 February 2019 |archive-date=2 February 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190202160635/http://www.ficmec.es/ficmec2016/noticia40.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Works==

* ''El país de los pájaros que duermen en el aire'', Espasa, 2018, {{ISBN|9788467051810}}
